methods.black: Black to upper-edge tint: R=u*t, L=t; reversal of addBlack.
methods.white: Black-vivid shade to white: addWhite({R:v,L:v}, a).
methods.normalizedLightness: Gen L divided by Gen L of the same ray endpoint; diagnostic only.
methods.stepStats: Euclidean GenSpace steps, trim two endpoint steps for CV/jump; all steps for direction.
methods.negativeLightness: Increasing path parameter lowers Gen L by >1e-8; Descriptive only: a chromatic full-gamut endpoint can have Gen L above white, so a decrease toward white is not by itself an error.
methods.cornerProgress: Black family reports decreases in distance from black; white family reports increases in distance to white, both in full three-dimensional GenSpace. These are external-ruler diagnostics, not redefinitions of HRL shares.
methods.invalidDomain: Entire path unavailable if pinned GenSpace needs negative-response clipping. No display clipping in analysis.

note: No new fitting or observer data. Existing COMBVD scores unchanged. These are model-based diagnostics, not verified human preferences.
